caption:
This store charges you before you buy anything.

It is called a membership fee. The fee helps keep prices low. 92.3% of U.S. and Canada members renewed in 2025.

Would you pay a yearly fee to shop if the prices were lower?

#Costco #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

Most McDonald's restaurants aren't run by McDonald's.

Independent franchisees run the restaurants. McDonald's earns rent and royalties. About 95% were franchised at the end of 2025.

Did you know who runs most McDonald's locations?

#McDonalds #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

This furniture saves money before you build it.

IKEA designs many products to fit in flat packs. Flat boxes use less storage and shipping space. IKEA says this helps lower transport costs.

Would you assemble furniture yourself for a lower price?

#IKEA #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

Some coffee money arrives before the coffee is sold.

Customers load value onto gift cards. The card can be spent on future orders. Starbucks reports stored value as a liability.

Do you ever preload money into a coffee app?

#Starbucks #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

Why are so many products here store brands?

ALDI fills most shelves with its own labels. That gives it more control over the assortment. ALDI says over 90% of its products are private label.

Do you trust store brands as much as famous brands?

#ALDI #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The company behind the soda doesn't bottle all of it.

Coca-Cola sells concentrates and syrups. Bottling partners add water and package drinks. Its 2025 report describes both business lines.

Did you know who actually bottles the drinks?

#CocaCola #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The name on your card isn't your bank.

Visa operates a payment network. Banks issue cards and extend credit. Visa says it does neither of those things.

Did you think Visa issued the card itself?

#Visa #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

One music app has two ways to get paid.

Free listeners hear ads. Premium listeners pay a subscription. Spotify describes its free tier as ad supported.

Do you use the free or paid version?

#Spotify #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The software sale became a recurring payment.

Creative Cloud is sold through subscriptions. Customers pay for continuing access to the tools. Adobe reported $22.8 billion in subscription revenue in 2025.

Do you prefer subscriptions or one-time purchases?

#Adobe #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The online store isn't the whole business.

Amazon also sells cloud computing through AWS. Companies pay to run software on its infrastructure. AWS made $45.6 billion in operating income in 2025.

Did you expect the cloud to be this important to Amazon?

#Amazon #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The phone sale is only the start.

Apple also sells digital services. These include App Store and subscription offerings. Services sales reached $109.2 billion in fiscal 2025.

Which service do you use most after buying a phone?

#Apple #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The movie can end. the business story keeps going.

Disney sells park tickets, resort stays and merchandise. Its stories become physical experiences. Experiences revenue was $36.2 billion in fiscal 2025.

Have you ever visited a place because of a story you loved?

#Disney #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The ticket isn't the only thing for sale.

Low cost airlines also sell optional extras. Bags, seats and other add ons create revenue. Ryanair reports ancillary revenue separately.

Which airline extra do you actually pay for?

#Ryanair #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The host sets the stay. the platform earns a fee.

Airbnb connects guests with hosts. Service fees are added or deducted at booking. Airbnb's help page explains its two fee structures.

Do you check the full price before you book?

#Airbnb #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The online store is only the beginning.

Shopify sells merchant subscriptions. It also earns from payments and other merchant tools. Shopify reports these as two revenue categories.

What tool would you need first to start an online store?

#Shopify #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The same shoe can reach you two ways.

Nike sells to wholesale retailers. It also sells directly to consumers. Its 2025 results report both sales channels.

Where do you usually buy sports shoes?

#Nike #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

One app sells two very different trips.

Uber connects riders with drivers. It also connects food customers with couriers. Its 2025 results report mobility and delivery separately.

Which do you use more: rides or delivery?

#Uber #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The lesson is free. the business isn't.

Duolingo lets people start without paying. Subscriptions and ads help fund the service. Only 9.2% of average monthly users subscribed in 2025.

Would you pay to remove limits from a learning app?

#Duolingo #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

Selling the console is only the first move.

Nintendo also sells games and digital content. The device creates a place to buy more experiences. Its annual report lists hardware, software and online sales.

What was the first game you bought for a new console?

#Nintendo #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The brick stays familiar. the set keeps changing.

LEGO releases new building sets each year. New themes give fans new reasons to build. About half of its 860 plus 2025 products were new.

Do you keep your sets built or rebuild them?

#LEGO #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The racks change. that is part of the strategy.

TJX buys merchandise opportunistically. The mix can change as new deals appear. TJX calls this approach opportunistic buying.

Do you enjoy hunting for an unexpected bargain?

#TJX #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The luxury empire is more than one label.

LVMH owns houses across several categories. Fashion, beauty and retail all contribute. Its 2025 results report five main business groups.

Which luxury category surprises you most?

#LVMH #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The car company also sells giant batteries.

Tesla's energy business includes storage products. Megapack and Powerwall are part of that line. Energy revenue rose 27% in 2025.

Did you know Tesla had a storage business?

#Tesla #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The grocery aisle can also sell ad space.

Brands pay to reach shoppers in Walmart's channels. Retail data helps connect ads with shopping. Walmart said global advertising reached $4.4 billion.

Do sponsored products change what you buy?

#Walmart #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The app is free. advertisers pay.

Meta connects businesses with people on its apps. Advertisers buy placements to reach audiences. Meta reports advertising as its main revenue source.

How often do you notice an ad in your feed?

#Meta #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

Search results are only one side of Google.

Google services makes money from ads and subscriptions. Google Cloud sells computing and workspace to businesses. Alphabet reports these as distinct businesses.

Which Google product do you use every day?

#Alphabet #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The game world has its own money.

Players buy virtual currency. They can spend it on digital items. Roblox says most bookings come from virtual currency sales.

Have you ever paid for a virtual item?

#Roblox #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

A streaming subscription can still show ads.

Netflix offers an ad supported plan. That adds another way to earn from viewing. Netflix said growing ads was a 2025 priority.

Would you accept ads for a cheaper subscription?

#Netflix #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

The hotel listing is part of a bigger machine.

Booking connects travelers with places to stay. It earns through merchant and agency models. Booking Holdings reports both revenue lines.

Do you book directly with hotels or through a platform?

#Bookingcom #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal

This retailer grows by being close by.

Dollar General sells everyday essentials. Its stores serve many small communities. It reported 20,893 stores in january 2026.

How far is your nearest everyday-essentials store?

#DollarGeneral #BusinessModel #TheBusinessReveal
